func _crowd_priority_lane(model) -> int:
 var chosen=-1

  var lane_queue:Array=model.queues[direction]

  var head:Dictionary=lane_queue[0]
  var deadline=float(head.arrived_at)+float(head.patience)
  if deadline<earliest_deadline:
   earliest_deadline=deadline
   chosen=direction
 return chosen

## Dispatch a complete, observable pointer click through the normal input route.
## Both coordinates matter: Input tracks global_position, while Viewport hit-tests
## position. Leaving global_position at zero moves the tracked pointer to (0, 0)
## between events even if gui_get_hovered_control() briefly reports the target.
func _native_click_button(button: BaseButton, context: String) -> bool:
 if not is_instance_valid(button) or not button.is_visible_in_tree() or button.disabled:
  await _fail("Native click target is missing, hidden or disabled: " + context)
  return false
 var ancestor := button.get_parent()
 while ancestor != null:
  if ancestor is ScrollContainer: ancestor.ensure_control_visible(button)
  ancestor = ancestor.get_parent()
 await get_tree().process_frame
 await get_tree().process_frame
 var viewport := button.get_viewport()
 var rect := button.get_global_rect()
 var visible_rect := viewport.get_visible_rect()
 ancestor = button.get_parent()
 while ancestor != null:
  if ancestor is Control and ancestor.clip_contents:
   visible_rect = visible_rect.intersection(ancestor.get_global_rect())
  ancestor = ancestor.get_parent()
 if not visible_rect.encloses(rect):
  await _fail("Native click target is clipped: %s rect=%s visible=%s" % [context, rect, visible_rect])
  return false
 var observation := {"down": 0, "up": 0, "pressed": 0, "gui": []}
 var on_down := func(): observation.down += 1
 var on_up := func(): observation.up += 1
 var on_pressed := func(): observation.pressed += 1
 var on_gui := func(event: InputEvent):
  if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
   observation.gui.append("down" if event.pressed else "up")
 button.button_down.connect(on_down)
 button.button_up.connect(on_up)
 button.pressed.connect(on_pressed)
 button.gui_input.connect(on_gui)
 var target_path := str(button.get_path())
 var point := viewport.get_final_transform() * rect.get_center()
 # Flush queued OS/fixture events before beginning this click. No input state,
 # control signal or gameplay callback is assigned or invoked directly.
 Input.flush_buffered_events()
 var motion := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
 motion.position = point
 motion.global_position = point
 motion.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
 motion.button_mask = Input.get_mouse_button_mask()
 Input.parse_input_event(motion)
 Input.flush_buffered_events()
 var hovered := viewport.gui_get_hovered_control()
 var diagnostics := "target=%s rect=%s pointer=%s hovered=%s button_hovered=%s initial_mask=%d" % [target_path, rect, point, str(hovered.get_path()) if is_instance_valid(hovered) else "none", button.is_hovered(), Input.get_mouse_button_mask()]
 if not button.is_hovered() or not (hovered == button or is_instance_valid(hovered) and button.is_ancestor_of(hovered)):
  for pair in [[button.button_down, on_down], [button.button_up, on_up], [button.pressed, on_pressed], [button.gui_input, on_gui]]:
   pair[0].disconnect(pair[1])
  await _fail("Native pointer did not hover its target: %s; %s" % [context, diagnostics])
  return false
 # Dispatch and flush each distinct event without yielding to unrelated OS
 # motion or deferred focus changes between the observed down and release.
 for is_down in [true, false]:
  var event := InputEventMouseButton.new()
  event.position = point
  event.global_position = point
  event.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
  event.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
  event.button_mask = MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT if is_down else 0
  event.pressed = is_down
  Input.parse_input_event(event)
  Input.flush_buffered_events()
 if is_instance_valid(button):
  for pair in [[button.button_down, on_down], [button.button_up, on_up], [button.pressed, on_pressed], [button.gui_input, on_gui]]:
   pair[0].disconnect(pair[1])
 diagnostics += " observed=%s final_mask=%d" % [observation, Input.get_mouse_button_mask()]
 if observation.down != 1 or observation.pressed != 1:
  await _fail("Native click did not activate its target: %s; %s" % [context, diagnostics])
  return false
 print("INPUT: ", context, " ", diagnostics)
 await get_tree().process_frame

const NativeReviewBase = preload("res://work/tutorial-current-20261020/lifecycle/native_review.gd")
const GLOBAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS := 360.0
const PER_GAME_TIMEOUT_SECONDS := 60.0
var main: Node
var failures: Array[String] = []
var finished := false
var active_game := ""
var active_phase := "startup"
var global_deadline_msec := 0
var game_deadline_msec := 0

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	if not finished and global_deadline_msec > 0 and now >= global_deadline_msec:
		_watchdog("global 360-second wall-clock deadline")
	elif not finished and game_deadline_msec > 0 and now >= game_deadline_msec:
		_watchdog("%s exceeded 60 seconds during %s" % [active_game, active_phase])
	if not Engine.get_write_movie_path().is_empty():
		RenderingServer.force_draw(false, 0.0)

func _ready() -> void:
	if OS.get_environment("SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH").is_empty() or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		push_error("Native tutorial lifecycle review requires a GPU window and isolated SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH")
		get_tree().quit(1)
		return
	global_deadline_msec = Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(GLOBAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS * 1000.0)
	call_deferred("_run")

func _check(ok: bool, message: String) -> void:
	if not ok:
		failures.append(message)
		push_error("FAIL: " + message)

func _run() -> void:
	var first_game := 1
	var last_game := 12
	for argument in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if argument.begins_with("--tutorial-first=") or argument.begins_with("--tutorial-last="):
			var value: String = argument.get_slice("=", 1)
			_check(value.is_valid_int(), "tutorial batch bounds are integers")
			if argument.begins_with("--tutorial-first="): first_game = value.to_int()
			else: last_game = value.to_int()
	_check(first_game >= 1 and last_game <= 12 and first_game <= last_game, "tutorial batch stays within the twelve real games")
	if not failures.is_empty():
		_finish(1)
		return
	var progress := get_tree().root.get_node_or_null("Progress")
	_check(progress != null, "Progress autoload exists")
	if progress == null:
		_finish()
		return
	progress.reset_progress()
	progress.intro_seen = true
	progress.save_progress()
	for number in range(1, 13):
		_check(not progress.has_seen_tutorial("game-%03d" % number), "new-player fixture leaves game-%03d unseen" % number)
	var native_review := NativeReviewBase.new()
	main = native_review._instantiate_main(false)
	native_review.free()
	get_tree().root.add_child(main)
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.5).timeout
	for number in range(first_game, last_game + 1):
		if finished: return
		_begin_game_watchdog("game-%03d" % number)
		await _review_game(number, progress)
		_end_game_watchdog()
		if not failures.is_empty():
			_finish(1)
			return
	_finish()

func _settle_near_station(id: String) -> void:
	var deadline := Time.get_ticks_msec() + 3000
	while Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline and str(main.world.nearest.get("id", "")) != id:
		await get_tree().physics_frame
	_check(str(main.world.nearest.get("id", "")) == id, id + " is selected by proximity")

func _wait_until(predicate: Callable, label: String, seconds := 3.0) -> void:
	var deadline := Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(seconds * 1000.0)
	while not predicate.call() and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline:
		await get_tree().process_frame
	_check(predicate.call(), "timed out waiting for " + label)

func _wait_frames(count: int) -> void:
	for _frame in count:
		await get_tree().process_frame

func _click_text(root: Node, label: String) -> void:
	var found := _find_button(root, label)
	if found == null:
		_check(false, "button is visible for pointer click: " + label)
		return
	await _native_click(found, label)

func _click_named(root: Node, node_name: String) -> void:
	var found := root.find_child(node_name, true, false) as BaseButton
	if found == null:
		_check(false, "named button exists for pointer click: " + node_name)
		return
	await _native_click(found, node_name)

func _find_button(root: Node, label: String) -> BaseButton:
	if root == null: return null
	for child in root.get_children():
		if child is BaseButton and str(child.text) == label and child.is_visible_in_tree() and not child.disabled:
			return child
		var nested := _find_button(child, label)
		if nested != null: return nested
	return null

func _native_click(button: BaseButton, context: String) -> void:
	if not button.is_visible_in_tree() or button.disabled:
		_check(false, "click target is visible and enabled: " + context)
		return
	for ancestor in _ancestors(button):
		if ancestor is ScrollContainer: ancestor.ensure_control_visible(button)
	await _wait_frames(2)
	var viewport := button.get_viewport()
	var point: Vector2 = viewport.get_final_transform() * button.get_global_rect().get_center()
	Input.flush_buffered_events()
	var motion := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
	motion.position = point
	motion.global_position = point
	motion.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
	Input.parse_input_event(motion)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()
	_check(button.is_hovered(), "real pointer reaches " + context)
	for pressed in [true, false]:
		var event := InputEventMouseButton.new()
		event.position = point
		event.global_position = point
		event.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
		event.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
		event.button_mask = MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT if pressed else 0
		event.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(event)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
	await _wait_frames(2)

func _ancestors(node: Node) -> Array[Node]:
	var result: Array[Node] = []
	var parent := node.get_parent()
	while parent != null:
		result.append(parent)
		parent = parent.get_parent()
	return result

func _key(keycode: Key) -> void:
	for pressed in [true, false]:
		var event := InputEventKey.new()
		event.keycode = keycode
		event.physical_keycode = keycode
		event.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
		event.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(event)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
		await get_tree().process_frame

func _draw_and_capture(filename: String) -> void:
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	var image := get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
	_check(image != null and not image.is_empty(), "post-draw viewport image exists: " + filename)
	if image == null or image.is_empty(): return
	var folder := OS.get_environment("SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH").get_base_dir().path_join("captures")
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(folder)
	var path := folder.path_join(filename)
	_check(image.save_png(path) == OK, "native post-draw screenshot saved: " + path)

func _assert_lesson_image(panel: Control, context: String) -> void:
	_check(panel._image.texture is Texture2D and not panel._image_placeholder.visible, context + " displays its actual tutorial screenshot")

func _review_copy_pages(panel: Control, context: String) -> void:
	await _wait_frames(4)
	var seen: Array[bool] = [false, false, false, false, false]
	_check(panel._copy_sections.size() == 5, context + " retains all five instruction fields")
	for page_index in range(panel._copy_pages.size()):
		if page_index > 0:
			await _click_named(panel, "TutorialCopyNext")
		await _wait_frames(2)
		_check(panel._copy_page == page_index, context + " actual pointer opens copy page " + str(page_index))
		var clip: Rect2 = panel._text_scroll.get_global_rect()
		var group: Control = panel._copy_pages[page_index]
		_check(clip.encloses(group.get_global_rect()), context + " complete page fits without scrolling")
		for index in range(panel._copy_sections.size()):
			var section: Control = panel._copy_sections[index]
			if not section.is_visible_in_tree() or not clip.intersects(section.get_global_rect()): continue
			var readable := clip.encloses(section.get_global_rect())
			_check(readable, context + " complete field " + str(index) + " is visible")
			if readable: seen[index] = true
			for label in section.get_children():
				if label is Label:
					_check(clip.grow(1).encloses(label.get_global_rect()), context + " visible text is not partially clipped")
	for index in range(seen.size()):
		_check(seen[index], context + " field " + str(index) + " was actually shown")
	while panel._copy_page > 0:
		await _click_named(panel, "TutorialCopyPrevious")

func _persistent_snapshot(progress: Node) -> Dictionary:
	return {

extends Node

const NativeReviewBase = preload("res://game/tests/native_review.gd")
const GLOBAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS := 360.0
const PER_GAME_TIMEOUT_SECONDS := 60.0
var main: Node
var failures: Array[String] = []
var finished := false
var active_game := ""
var active_phase := "startup"
var global_deadline_msec := 0
var game_deadline_msec := 0

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	if not finished and global_deadline_msec > 0 and now >= global_deadline_msec:
		_watchdog("global 360-second wall-clock deadline")
	elif not finished and game_deadline_msec > 0 and now >= game_deadline_msec:
		_watchdog("%s exceeded 60 seconds during %s" % [active_game, active_phase])
	if not Engine.get_write_movie_path().is_empty():
		RenderingServer.force_draw(false, 0.0)

func _ready() -> void:
	if OS.get_environment("SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH").is_empty() or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		push_error("Native tutorial lifecycle review requires a GPU window and isolated SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH")
		get_tree().quit(1)
		return
	global_deadline_msec = Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(GLOBAL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS * 1000.0)
	call_deferred("_run")

func _check(ok: bool, message: String) -> void:
	if not ok:
		failures.append(message)
		push_error("FAIL: " + message)

func _run() -> void:
	var first_game := 1
	var last_game := 12
	for argument in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if argument.begins_with("--tutorial-first=") or argument.begins_with("--tutorial-last="):
			var value: String = argument.get_slice("=", 1)
			_check(value.is_valid_int(), "tutorial batch bounds are integers")
			if argument.begins_with("--tutorial-first="): first_game = value.to_int()
			else: last_game = value.to_int()
	_check(first_game >= 1 and last_game <= 12 and first_game <= last_game, "tutorial batch stays within the twelve real games")
	if not failures.is_empty():
		_finish(1)
		return
	var progress := get_tree().root.get_node_or_null("Progress")
	_check(progress != null, "Progress autoload exists")
	if progress == null:
		_finish()
		return
	progress.reset_progress()
	progress.intro_seen = true
	progress.save_progress()
	for number in range(1, 13):
		_check(not progress.has_seen_tutorial("game-%03d" % number), "new-player fixture leaves game-%03d unseen" % number)
	var native_review := NativeReviewBase.new()
	main = native_review._instantiate_main(false)
	native_review.free()
	get_tree().root.add_child(main)
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.5).timeout
	for number in range(first_game, last_game + 1):
		if finished: return
		_begin_game_watchdog("game-%03d" % number)
		await _review_game(number, progress)
		_end_game_watchdog()
		if not failures.is_empty():
			_finish(1)
			return
	_finish()

func _review_game(number: int, progress: Node) -> void:
	var id := "game-%03d" % number
	var game_failure_count := failures.size()
	_set_phase(id, "select station")
	var station: Dictionary = {}
	for point in main.world.points:
		if str(point.get("id", "")) == id:
			station = point
	_check(not station.is_empty(), id + " station is present")
	if station.is_empty(): return
	# Station positioning is the sole fixture shortcut; all menus, tutorial navigation,
	# pause/resume, and session help are activated through window input events.
	main.world.player.position = station.position + Vector3(0, 0.3, 0)
	await _settle_near_station(id)
	await _key(KEY_E)
	await _wait_until(func(): return main.modal_kind == "game_info", id + " info screen")
	if main.modal_kind != "game_info": return
	_check(not Progress.has_seen_tutorial(id), id + " begins with an unseen tutorial")
	_set_phase(id, "first Start opens tutorial")
	await _click_text(main.overlay, "開始遊玩")
	await _wait_until(func(): return is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel), id + " first-entry tutorial from Start")
	if not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel): return
	var panel: Control = main.tutorial_panel
	_check(panel.current_step_data().size() > 0 and panel.current_step_data().has("image"), id + " first lesson step has real screenshot data")
	_assert_lesson_image(panel, id + " step 1")
	await _review_copy_pages(panel, id + " step 1")
	await _draw_and_capture("%s-first-step.png" % id)
	for step in range(1, 3):
		_set_phase(id, "navigate tutorial step %d" % (step + 1))
		var use_keyboard := (number + step) % 2 == 0
		if use_keyboard:
			await _key(KEY_RIGHT)
		else:
			await _click_text(panel, "下一步")
		_check(panel.current_step == step, "%s lesson reaches step %d by %s input" % [id, step + 1, "keyboard" if use_keyboard else "mouse"])
		_assert_lesson_image(panel, id + " step " + str(step + 1))
		await _review_copy_pages(panel, id + " step " + str(step + 1))
		await _draw_and_capture("%s-step-%02d.png" % [id, step + 1])
	_set_phase(id, "keyboard previous/next round trip")
	await _key(KEY_LEFT)
	_check(panel.current_step == 1, id + " keyboard Left returns to the prior step")
	_assert_lesson_image(panel, id + " keyboard Left")
	await _key(KEY_RIGHT)
	_check(panel.current_step == 2, id + " keyboard Right returns to the last step")
	_assert_lesson_image(panel, id + " keyboard Right")
	var launch_label := "開始挑戰" if number % 2 == 1 else "略過"
	_set_phase(id, "launch via " + launch_label)
	await _click_text(panel, launch_label)
	await _wait_until(func(): return main.session != null, id + " " + launch_label + " starts selected session")
	if main.session == null: return
	var session: Node = main.session
	_check(session.game_id == id, id + " begins the selected game")
	_check(Progress.has_seen_tutorial(id), id + " Begin or Skip persists learned state")
	await _wait_until(func(): return not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel), id + " tutorial closes after begin")
	await _wait_frames(3)
	var before := _persistent_snapshot(progress)
	_set_phase(id, "HUD help pauses session")
	await _click_named(session, "HelpButton")
	await _wait_until(func(): return is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel) and session.paused, id + " HUD help pauses session")
	if not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel): return
	var elapsed_before := float(session.elapsed)
	var game_time_before := float(session.game_time)
	panel = main.tutorial_panel
	_set_phase(id, "capture real HUD help")
	await _draw_and_capture("%s-help-step-01.png" % id)
	await _wait_frames(90)
	_check(is_equal_approx(float(session.elapsed), elapsed_before), id + " tutorial holds round duration")
	_check(is_equal_approx(float(session.game_time), game_time_before), id + " tutorial holds model clock")
	_check(before == _persistent_snapshot(progress), id + " help leaves progress and equipment/platform data unchanged")
	_set_phase(id, "close HUD help to paused session")
	await _click_text(panel, "關閉")
	await _wait_until(func(): return not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel) and session.paused, id + " closing help returns to paused session")
	_check(before == _persistent_snapshot(progress), id + " close leaves persistent state unchanged")
	_set_phase(id, "explicit resume advances clocks")
	await _click_named(session.minigame_hud, "ResumeButton")
	await _wait_until(func(): return not session.paused, id + " ResumeButton restores the running session")
	if id == "game-001" and not session.balloon_started:
		_set_phase(id, "real Enter starts the timed Balloon round")
		await _key(KEY_ENTER)
		await _wait_until(func(): return session.balloon_started, id + " Enter starts Balloon timed play")
	await _wait_frames(45)
	_check(not session.paused and not session.ended, id + " resumed session remains active while clocks advance")
	_check(float(session.elapsed) > elapsed_before, id + " explicit resume advances duration")
	_check(float(session.game_time) > game_time_before, id + " explicit resume advances model clock")
	_set_phase(id, "pause menu replay path")
	await _click_named(session.minigame_hud, "PauseButton")
	await _wait_until(func(): return session.paused, id + " actual pause button pauses")
	await _click_named(session.minigame_hud, "HelpFromPauseButton")
	await _wait_until(func(): return is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel), id + " pause menu can reopen lesson")
	if not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel): return
	panel = main.tutorial_panel
	_check(panel.current_step == 0, id + " manual replay starts at first step")
	_set_phase(id, "capture manually reopened help")
	await _draw_and_capture("%s-help-reopened.png" % id)
	await _click_text(panel, "關閉")
	await _wait_until(func(): return not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel) and session.paused, id + " replay close retains pause")
	_check(before == _persistent_snapshot(progress), id + " replay leaves persistent state unchanged")
	_set_phase(id, "confirmed leave and direct reentry")
	await _click_named(session.minigame_hud, "LeaveButton")
	await _wait_until(func(): return session.minigame_hud.find_child("ConfirmAction", true, false) != null, id + " leave confirmation opens")
	await _click_named(session.minigame_hud, "ConfirmAction")
	await _wait_until(func(): return main.session == null, id + " confirmed leave returns to park")
	_check(main.modal_kind == "", id + " returns to park without an overlay")
	await _key(KEY_E)
	await _wait_until(func(): return main.modal_kind == "game_info", id + " reentry information screen")
	_check(not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel), id + " reentry does not automatically reopen tutorial")
	await _click_text(main.overlay, "開始遊玩")
	await _wait_until(func(): return main.session != null, id + " reentry launches directly")
	_check(not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel), id + " reentry skips first-entry tutorial")
	if main.session == null: return
	var practice_session: Node = main.session
	var private_before := _persistent_snapshot(progress)
	_set_phase(id, "reentry pause to private practice")
	await _click_named(practice_session.minigame_hud, "PauseButton")
	await _wait_until(func(): return practice_session.paused, id + " returning session pauses before private practice")
	await _click_named(practice_session.minigame_hud, "PracticeButton")
	await _wait_until(func(): return practice_session.practice_mode and not practice_session.paused, id + " actual pause action starts private practice")
	_check(main.session == practice_session, id + " private practice remains the actual Main session")
	_check(practice_session.practice_mode, id + " practice HUD action marks the session private")
	_check(private_before == _persistent_snapshot(progress), id + " starting private practice leaves the tracked progress snapshot unchanged")
	_set_phase(id, "private practice Help freezes clocks")
	await _click_named(practice_session.minigame_hud, "HelpButton")
	await _wait_until(func(): return is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel) and practice_session.paused, id + " private practice Help pauses and opens the tutorial")
	if not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel): return
	var practice_elapsed_before := float(practice_session.elapsed)
	var practice_clock_before := float(practice_session.game_time)
	_check(main.tutorial_origin == "session" and main.tutorial_target == id, id + " private Help displays this game's session tutorial")
	await _wait_frames(90)
	_check(is_equal_approx(float(practice_session.elapsed), practice_elapsed_before), id + " private tutorial holds round duration")
	_check(is_equal_approx(float(practice_session.game_time), practice_clock_before), id + " private tutorial holds model clock")
	_check(private_before == _persistent_snapshot(progress), id + " private tutorial does not alter tracked progression")
	var private_panel: Control = main.tutorial_panel
	await _draw_and_capture("%s-private-help-step-01.png" % id)
	await _click_text(private_panel, "關閉")
	await _wait_until(func(): return not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel) and practice_session.paused, id + " private Help closes back to paused practice")
	_check(private_before == _persistent_snapshot(progress), id + " closing private Help leaves tracked progression unchanged")
	_set_phase(id, "reopen private practice tutorial")
	await _click_named(practice_session.minigame_hud, "HelpFromPauseButton")
	await _wait_until(func(): return is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel), id + " private pause menu reopens its tutorial")
	if not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel): return
	_check(main.tutorial_panel.current_step == 0, id + " private tutorial replay starts at its first step")
	private_panel = main.tutorial_panel
	await _click_text(private_panel, "關閉")
	await _wait_until(func(): return not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel) and practice_session.paused, id + " private replay returns to paused practice")
	_check(private_before == _persistent_snapshot(progress), id + " replaying private Help leaves tracked progression unchanged")
	_set_phase(id, "confirmed private leave and post-practice reentry")
	await _click_named(practice_session.minigame_hud, "LeaveButton")
	await _wait_until(func(): return practice_session.minigame_hud.find_child("ConfirmAction", true, false) != null, id + " private leave confirmation opens")
	await _click_named(practice_session.minigame_hud, "ConfirmAction")
	await _wait_until(func(): return main.session == null, id + " confirmed private leave returns to park")
	_check(main.modal_kind == "" and not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel), id + " private leave restores park without a lesson overlay")
	_check(private_before == _persistent_snapshot(progress), id + " returning from private practice leaves tracked progression unchanged")
	await _key(KEY_E)
	await _wait_until(func(): return main.modal_kind == "game_info", id + " post-practice Start information screen")
	_check(not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel), id + " practice return keeps the game marked learned")
	await _click_text(main.overlay, "開始遊玩")
	await _wait_until(func(): return main.session != null, id + " post-practice Start launches directly")
	_check(not is_instance_valid(main.tutorial_panel), id + " post-practice Start does not repeat the tutorial")
	_check(main.session != null and not main.session.practice_mode, id + " direct post-practice launch remains a formal session")
	if main.session != null:
		var final_session: Node = main.session
		await _click_named(final_session.minigame_hud, "PauseButton")
		await _wait_until(func(): return final_session.paused, id + " final returning session pauses")
		await _click_named(final_session.minigame_hud, "LeaveButton")
		await _wait_until(func(): return final_session.minigame_hud.find_child("ConfirmAction", true, false) != null, id + " final leave confirmation opens")
		await _click_named(final_session.minigame_hud, "ConfirmAction")
		await _wait_until(func(): return main.session == null, id + " final confirmed leave returns to park")
	_check(private_before == _persistent_snapshot(progress), id + " all returning and private flows preserve tracked progression")
	_set_phase(id, "completed first-entry, formal help, private practice, and reentry")
	if failures.size() == game_failure_count:
		print("PASS: native tutorial lifecycle " + id)
	else:
		print("FAIL: native tutorial lifecycle %s (%d failure(s))" % [id, failures.size() - game_failure_count])

func _settle_near_station(id: String) -> void:
	var deadline := Time.get_ticks_msec() + 3000
	while Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline and str(main.world.nearest.get("id", "")) != id:
		await get_tree().physics_frame
	_check(str(main.world.nearest.get("id", "")) == id, id + " is selected by proximity")

func _wait_until(predicate: Callable, label: String, seconds := 3.0) -> void:
	var deadline := Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(seconds * 1000.0)
	while not predicate.call() and Time.get_ticks_msec() < deadline:
		await get_tree().process_frame
	_check(predicate.call(), "timed out waiting for " + label)

func _wait_frames(count: int) -> void:
	for _frame in count:
		await get_tree().process_frame

func _click_text(root: Node, label: String) -> void:
	var found := _find_button(root, label)
	if found == null:
		_check(false, "button is visible for pointer click: " + label)
		return
	await _native_click(found, label)

func _click_named(root: Node, node_name: String) -> void:
	var found := root.find_child(node_name, true, false) as BaseButton
	if found == null:
		_check(false, "named button exists for pointer click: " + node_name)
		return
	await _native_click(found, node_name)

func _find_button(root: Node, label: String) -> BaseButton:
	if root == null: return null
	for child in root.get_children():
		if child is BaseButton and str(child.text) == label and child.is_visible_in_tree() and not child.disabled:
			return child
		var nested := _find_button(child, label)
		if nested != null: return nested
	return null

func _native_click(button: BaseButton, context: String) -> void:
	if not button.is_visible_in_tree() or button.disabled:
		_check(false, "click target is visible and enabled: " + context)
		return
	for ancestor in _ancestors(button):
		if ancestor is ScrollContainer: ancestor.ensure_control_visible(button)
	await _wait_frames(2)
	var viewport := button.get_viewport()
	var point: Vector2 = viewport.get_final_transform() * button.get_global_rect().get_center()
	Input.flush_buffered_events()
	var motion := InputEventMouseMotion.new()
	motion.position = point
	motion.global_position = point
	motion.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
	Input.parse_input_event(motion)
	Input.flush_buffered_events()
	_check(button.is_hovered(), "real pointer reaches " + context)
	for pressed in [true, false]:
		var event := InputEventMouseButton.new()
		event.position = point
		event.global_position = point
		event.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
		event.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
		event.button_mask = MOUSE_BUTTON_MASK_LEFT if pressed else 0
		event.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(event)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
	await _wait_frames(2)

func _ancestors(node: Node) -> Array[Node]:
	var result: Array[Node] = []
	var parent := node.get_parent()
	while parent != null:
		result.append(parent)
		parent = parent.get_parent()
	return result

func _key(keycode: Key) -> void:
	for pressed in [true, false]:
		var event := InputEventKey.new()
		event.keycode = keycode
		event.physical_keycode = keycode
		event.window_id = get_window().get_window_id()
		event.pressed = pressed
		Input.parse_input_event(event)
		Input.flush_buffered_events()
		await get_tree().process_frame

func _draw_and_capture(filename: String) -> void:
	await get_tree().process_frame
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	var image := get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
	_check(image != null and not image.is_empty(), "post-draw viewport image exists: " + filename)
	if image == null or image.is_empty(): return
	var folder := ProjectSettings.globalize_path("res://.review/main10-lifecycle-evidence")
	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(folder)
	var path := folder.path_join(filename)
	_check(image.save_png(path) == OK, "native post-draw screenshot saved: " + path)

func _assert_lesson_image(panel: Control, context: String) -> void:
	_check(panel._image.texture is Texture2D and not panel._image_placeholder.visible, context + " displays its actual tutorial screenshot")

func _review_copy_pages(panel: Control, context: String) -> void:
	await _wait_frames(4)
	var seen: Array[bool] = [false, false, false, false, false]
	_check(panel._copy_sections.size() == 5, context + " retains all five instruction fields")
	for page_index in range(panel._copy_pages.size()):
		if page_index > 0:
			await _click_named(panel, "TutorialCopyNext")
		await _wait_frames(2)
		_check(panel._copy_page == page_index, context + " actual pointer opens copy page " + str(page_index))
		var clip: Rect2 = panel._text_scroll.get_global_rect()
		var group: Control = panel._copy_pages[page_index]
		_check(clip.encloses(group.get_global_rect()), context + " complete page fits without scrolling")
		for index in range(panel._copy_sections.size()):
			var section: Control = panel._copy_sections[index]
			if not section.is_visible_in_tree() or not clip.intersects(section.get_global_rect()): continue
			var readable := clip.encloses(section.get_global_rect())
			_check(readable, context + " complete field " + str(index) + " is visible")
			if readable: seen[index] = true
			for label in section.get_children():
				if label is Label:
					_check(clip.grow(1).encloses(label.get_global_rect()), context + " visible text is not partially clipped")
	for index in range(seen.size()):
		_check(seen[index], context + " field " + str(index) + " was actually shown")
	while panel._copy_page > 0:
		await _click_named(panel, "TutorialCopyPrevious")

func _persistent_snapshot(progress: Node) -> Dictionary:
	return {
		"photos": progress.photos.duplicate(true),
		"achievements": progress.achievements.duplicate(true),
		"quests": progress.quests.duplicate(true),
		"appearance": progress.appearance.duplicate(true),
		"equipped": progress.equipped.duplicate(true),
		"owned_clothes": progress.owned_clothes.duplicate(true),
		"coins": progress.coins,
		"platform_pending_achievements": progress.platform_pending_achievements.duplicate(true),
		"tutorial_seen_games": progress.tutorial_seen_games.duplicate(true),
	}

func _begin_game_watchdog(id: String) -> void:
	active_game = id
	active_phase = "starting"
	game_deadline_msec = Time.get_ticks_msec() + int(PER_GAME_TIMEOUT_SECONDS * 1000.0)
	print("NATIVE LIFECYCLE: ", id, " phase=starting (60-second wall-clock deadline)")

func _end_game_watchdog() -> void:
	game_deadline_msec = 0
	active_game = ""
	active_phase = "between games"

func _set_phase(id: String, phase: String) -> void:
	active_game = id
	active_phase = phase
	print("NATIVE LIFECYCLE: ", id, " phase=", phase)

func _watchdog(reason: String) -> void:
	if finished: return
	finished = true
	push_error("FAIL: tutorial lifecycle watchdog %s; game=%s phase=%s" % [reason, active_game, active_phase])
	get_tree().quit(1)

func _finish(exit_code := -1) -> void:
	if finished: return
	finished = true
	if exit_code < 0: exit_code = 1 if not failures.is_empty() else 0
	if main != null and is_instance_valid(main):
		if is_instance_valid(main.world):
			main.world.set_process(false)
			main.world.set_physics_process(false)
		if is_instance_valid(main.audio): main.audio.shutdown()
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
		main.queue_free()
	await get_tree().process_frame
	get_tree().quit(exit_code)

extends SceneTree

const Session = preload("res://game/minigames/session.gd")
var cases := 0
var failures := 0

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("_run")

func _run() -> void:
	if OS.get_environment("SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH").is_empty():
		push_error("Fountain timing tests require isolated SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH")
		quit(1)
		return
	_test_timing_bands()
	_test_session_view_output_and_headless_guard()
	_test_paused_viewport_retention()
	_test_three_jump_gate_and_equivalent_input()
	_test_misses_spam_and_slow_frames()
	_test_pause_assist_and_reduced_motion()
	if failures == 0:
		print("PASS: fountain timing checks (%d cases)" % cases)
		quit(0)
	else:
		push_error("Fountain timing checks: %d failures" % failures)
		quit(1)

func _test_paused_viewport_retention() -> void:
	# Renderer policy is independent of GPU availability. Native paired evidence
	# separately checks that UPDATE_ONCE retains exact pixels after the draw.
	var game: Control = Session.new()
	var view := Control.new()
	game.add_child(view)
	game.presentation = view
	var continuous := SubViewport.new()
	continuous.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS
	view.add_child(continuous)
	var visible := SubViewport.new()
	visible.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_WHEN_VISIBLE
	view.add_child(visible)
	var dormant := SubViewport.new()
	dormant.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED
	view.add_child(dormant)
	game.set_paused(true)
	_expect(continuous.render_target_update_mode == SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE and visible.render_target_update_mode == SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE, "pause schedules one complete retained frame for live stages")
	_expect(dormant.render_target_update_mode == SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED, "pause never wakes an intentionally disabled viewport")
	game.set_paused(true)
	game.set_paused(false)
	_expect(continuous.render_target_update_mode == SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS and visible.render_target_update_mode == SubViewport.UPDATE_WHEN_VISIBLE, "repeated pause preserves each stage's original resume policy")
	game.set_paused(true)
	game.reset_round()
	_expect(not game.paused and continuous.render_target_update_mode == SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS and visible.render_target_update_mode == SubViewport.UPDATE_WHEN_VISIBLE, "retry restores live renderer policies before resetting the round")
	game.set_paused(true)
	visible.free()
	game.set_paused(false)
	_expect(continuous.render_target_update_mode == SubViewport.UPDATE_ALWAYS, "restoring a stage safely ignores a freed sibling")
	game.free()

func _test_timing_bands() -> void:
	for sample in [
		[-0.071, "準確", 200], [-0.070, "完美", 300],
		[0.070, "完美", 300], [0.071, "準確", 200],
		[-0.161, "踩中", 100], [0.160, "準確", 200],
		[0.161, "踩中", 100], [0.220, "踩中", 100]
	]:
		var game := _new(false)
		game._process(game.FOUNTAIN_FIRST_BEAT + float(sample[0]))
		_press_key(game)
		_expect(game.fountain_grades == [sample[1]] and game.score == int(sample[2]), "timing band at %s sec" % sample[0])
		game.queue_free()
	_expect(true, "timing bands complete")

func _test_session_view_output_and_headless_guard() -> void:
	var session := _new(false)
	if DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
		_expect(session.presentation_mode == "fountain_timing" and session.presentation == null and session._fountain_output == null, "headless fountain session records its mode without allocating a SubViewport or output TextureRect")
	var image := Image.create(2, 2, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
	image.fill(Color("#75c5c0"))
	var texture := ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)
	var output: TextureRect = session.call("_attach_fountain_output", session, texture) as TextureRect
	_expect(output != null and output.get_parent() == session and output.texture == texture, "session's production output helper attaches the supplied SubViewport texture to a scaled TextureRect")
	_expect(output != null and output.expand_mode == TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE and output.stretch_mode == TextureRect.STRETCH_SCALE and output.mouse_filter == Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE, "render output fills the stage without intercepting timing input")
	session.queue_free()
	cases += 1

func _test_three_jump_gate_and_equivalent_input() -> void:
	for click_input in [false, true]:
		var game := _new(false)
		var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
		game.finished.connect(func(result: Dictionary): results.append(result))
		for index in 3:
			var target: float = game._fountain_beat_time(index) + (0.10 if index == 1 else 0.0)
			game._process(target - game.phase)
			if click_input:
				_press_click(game)
			else:
				_press_key(game)
			if index == 0:
				_press_key(game)
				_expect(game.fountain_attempts == 1, "repeat press cannot spend the following opportunity")
			if index == 2:
				_expect(game.fountain_finish_pending and not game.ended and results.is_empty(), "third jump scores immediately but remains live through animation")
		var until_landing: float = game.fountain_finish_at - game.phase
		game._process(maxf(0.0, until_landing - 0.02))
		_expect(not game.ended and results.is_empty(), "result waits through the landing-settle interval")
		game._process(0.03)
		_expect(results.size() == 1 and results[0].success and not results[0].devil and game.count == 3, "three hits unlock ordinary only")
		_expect(game.score == 800, "three jump scores reflect 300 + 200 + 300")
		game.queue_free()
		cases += 1
	var perfect := _new(false)
	for index in 3:
		perfect._process(perfect._fountain_beat_time(index) - perfect.phase)
		_press_key(perfect)
	_expect(perfect.fountain_finish_pending and not perfect.ended, "perfect third input begins an authored landing before result")
	perfect._process(perfect.FOUNTAIN_JUMP_DURATION)
	_expect(not perfect.ended, "all eight jump-frame intervals play before result")
	perfect._process(perfect.FOUNTAIN_LANDING_SETTLE_SECONDS)
	_expect(perfect.won and perfect.devil_won and perfect.score == 900, "three perfect jumps unlock devil")
	perfect.queue_free()
	cases += 1

func _test_misses_spam_and_slow_frames() -> void:
	var too_early := _new(false)
	too_early._process(too_early.FOUNTAIN_FIRST_BEAT - too_early._fountain_hit_tolerance() - 0.02)
	_press_key(too_early)
	_expect(too_early.fountain_attempts == 0 and too_early.mistakes == 0, "pre-cue input does not burn a jump")
	too_early.queue_free()
	var no_input := _new(false)
	var results: Array[Dictionary] = []
	no_input.finished.connect(func(result: Dictionary): results.append(result))
	no_input._process(4.5)
	_expect(results.size() == 1 and not results[0].success and no_input.fountain_attempts == 3 and no_input.mistakes == 3 and not no_input.fountain_finish_pending, "idle deadlines resolve all three chances once without a nonexistent last jump")
	_expect(no_input.score_events.size() == 3 and no_input.score_events.all(func(row: Dictionary): return int(row.amount) == 0), "misses remain visible zero-point score rows")
	no_input.queue_free()
	cases += 1

func _test_pause_assist_and_reduced_motion() -> void:
	var paused := _new(false)
	paused._process(paused.FOUNTAIN_FIRST_BEAT)
	_press_key(paused)
	var phase_before: float = paused.phase
	paused.set_paused(true)
	paused._process(1.0)
	_expect(is_equal_approx(paused.phase, phase_before) and paused.fountain_attempts == 1, "pause freezes the next fountain deadline")
	paused.set_paused(false)
	paused.queue_free()
	var assisted := _new(true)
	assisted._process(assisted.FOUNTAIN_FIRST_BEAT + 0.30)
	_press_key(assisted)
	_expect(assisted.count == 1 and assisted.fountain_grades == ["踩中"], "assist widens timing without autoplay")
	assisted.queue_free()
	var reduced := _new(false)
	reduced.reduced_motion = true
	for index in 3:
		reduced._process(reduced._fountain_beat_time(index) - reduced.phase)
		_press_key(reduced)
	_expect(reduced.fountain_finish_pending and not reduced.ended, "reduced-motion run still waits for landing")
	reduced._process(reduced.fountain_finish_at - reduced.phase)
	_expect(reduced.won and reduced.devil_won and reduced.score == 900, "reduced motion preserves timing and eligibility")
	reduced.queue_free()
	var settling := _new(false)
	var settle_results: Array[Dictionary] = []
	settling.finished.connect(func(result: Dictionary): settle_results.append(result))
	for index in 3:
		settling._process(settling._fountain_beat_time(index) - settling.phase)
		_press_key(settling)
	var paused_phase: float = settling.phase
	settling.set_paused(true)
	settling._process(1.0)
	_expect(settling.fountain_finish_pending and not settling.ended and settle_results.is_empty() and is_equal_approx(settling.phase, paused_phase), "pause freezes pending result until landing resumes")
	settling.set_paused(false)
	settling._process(0.01)
	var settle_remaining: float = settling.fountain_finish_at - settling.phase
	settling._process(maxf(0.0, settle_remaining - 0.02))
	_expect(not settling.ended and settle_results.is_empty(), "resume does not catch up paused landing time")
	settling._process(0.03)
	settling._process(0.3)
	_expect(settle_results.size() == 1 and settle_results[0].success and settle_results[0].devil and settle_results[0].score == 900, "pending perfect result emits exactly once after the landing")
	settling.queue_free()
	cases += 3

func _new(assist: bool) -> Control:
	var game: Control = Session.new()
	root.add_child(game)
	game.start("game-003", assist)
	return game

func _press_key(game: Control) -> void:
	var event := InputEventKey.new()
	event.keycode = KEY_SPACE
	event.pressed = true
	game._unhandled_input(event)

func _press_click(game: Control) -> void:
	var event := InputEventMouseButton.new()
	event.button_index = MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
	event.pressed = true
	event.position = Vector2(640, 360)
	game._unhandled_input(event)

func _expect(condition: bool, message: String) -> void:
	if not condition:
		failures += 1
		push_error("Fountain timing check failed: " + message)
		return
	cases += 1

extends SceneTree

const View = preload("res://game/minigames/pipe_plan_view.gd")
const Model = preload("res://game/minigames/pipe_round_model.gd")
const Session = preload("res://game/minigames/session.gd")
var failures := 0
var checks := 0

func _initialize() -> void:
	call_deferred("_run")

func _run() -> void:
	var view: Control = View.new()
	root.add_child(view)
	await process_frame
	_test_board_mapping(view)
	_test_present_is_immutable(view)
	_test_flow_and_bloom(view)
	_test_cache_and_pause(view)
	_test_multi_target_order(view)
	_test_flower_bed_bounds_and_bloom(view)
	_test_actual_hud_clearance(view)
	_test_session_pause_delivery()
	view.queue_free()
	await process_frame
	if failures == 0:
		print("PASS: pipe plan view checks (%d checks)" % checks)
		quit(0)
	else:
		quit(1)

func _test_board_mapping(view: Control) -> void:
	var rect: Rect2 = view.get_board_rect()
	_expect(view.cell_at(rect.position) == 0, "board top-left maps to inlet tile")
	_expect(view.cell_at(rect.end - Vector2(0.01, 0.01)) == 15, "last point inside board maps to outlet tile")
	_expect(view.cell_at(rect.position - Vector2(0.01, 0.0)) == -1, "point before board is rejected")
	_expect(view.cell_at(rect.end) == -1, "right-bottom border is exclusive")
	_expect(view.cell_at(Vector2(-1, -1)) == -1, "unrelated point is rejected")
	view.custom_minimum_size = Vector2.ZERO
	view.size = Vector2(640, 360)
	var local_center := (rect.position + rect.size / 8.0) * 0.5
	_expect(view.cell_at(view.design_point_from_local(local_center)) == 0, "scaled local pointer maps through design coordinates")

func _test_session_pause_delivery() -> void:
	var session: Control = Session.new()
	root.add_child(session)
	session.start("game-007", false)
	var presentation: Control = session.presentation
	_expect(presentation != null and presentation.animation_active, "live Session starts the water presentation")
	session.set_paused(true)
	_expect(not presentation.animation_active, "pause immediately delivers the paused state to the 2D water animation")
	session._process(0.5)
	_expect(not presentation.animation_active, "paused ticks keep the 2D water animation stopped")
	session.set_paused(false)
	session._process(0.0)
	_expect(presentation.animation_active, "resume restores the live 2D water animation")
	session.queue_free()

func _test_present_is_immutable(view: Control) -> void:
	var cells: Array = [5,3,10,0,3,10,12,0,0,0,5,0,0,0,3,12]
	var before: Array = cells.duplicate(true)
	view.present(cells, 6, 2, false, 0.0, false)
	_expect(cells == before, "present does not mutate caller cells")
	_expect(view.cells == before and view.cursor == 6 and view.move_count == 2, "present copies puzzle state")
	_expect(view.flow_progress == 0.0 and not view.bloom_visible(), "disconnected board has no water payoff")

func _test_flow_and_bloom(view: Control) -> void:
	var solved: Array = [5,3,10,0,3,10,12,0,0,0,5,0,0,0,3,12]
	view.configure(false, "noon")
	view.present(solved, 15, 4, true, 12.0, false)
	_expect(view.flow_route == [0,4,5,6,10,14,15], "connected water follows reciprocal path in order")
	_expect(is_equal_approx(view.flow_progress, 0.0), "normal flow begins at the inlet")
	view._process(0.6)
	_expect(view.flow_progress > 0.0 and view.flow_progress < 1.0, "normal flow animates continuously")
	view.present(solved, 15, 4, true, 12.0, true)
	_expect(view.flow_progress < 1.0, "round end does not skip the visible water payoff")
	view.configure(true, "night")
	_expect(is_equal_approx(view.flow_progress, 1.0) and view.bloom_visible(), "reduced motion shows completed static bloom")
	view.present(solved, 0, 0, false, 0.0, false)
	_expect(is_equal_approx(view.flow_progress, 0.0) and not view.bloom_visible(), "new unconnected puzzle resets payoff")

func _test_cache_and_pause(view: Control) -> void:
	var solved: Array = [5,3,10,0,3,10,12,0,0,0,5,0,0,0,3,12]
	view.configure(false, "noon")
	view.set_animation_active(true)
	view.present(solved, 15, 4, true, 0.0, false)
	view._process(0.25)
	var initial_rebuilds: int = view.route_rebuild_count
	var progress_before_pause: float = view.flow_progress
	view.set_animation_active(false)
	view._process(0.5)
	_expect(is_equal_approx(view.flow_progress, progress_before_pause), "paused gameplay freezes water animation")
	view.set_animation_active(true)
	view.present(solved.duplicate(), 14, 5, true, 0.0, false)
	_expect(view.route_rebuild_count == initial_rebuilds, "cursor and move updates reuse cached route")
	view._process(0.5)
	_expect(view.flow_progress > progress_before_pause, "unpaused gameplay advances flow animation (%f → %f, active=%s, connected=%s, reduced=%s)" % [progress_before_pause, view.flow_progress, str(view.animation_active), str(view.connected), str(view.reduced_motion)])

func _test_multi_target_order(view: Control) -> void:
	var order: Dictionary = Model.DEFAULT_ORDERS[1]
	var model = Model.new()
	model.reset([order, order, order])
	for cell in range(16):
		var rotated := int(model.cells[cell])
		var turns := 0
		while rotated != int(order.solution_cells[cell]) and turns < 4:
			rotated = ((rotated << 1) & 15) | (rotated >> 3)
			turns += 1
		for _turn in range(turns):
			model.rotate(cell)
	view.present_order(model.snapshot(), 4.0, false, "noon")
	_expect(view.order_targets == [[3, 0], [12, 2]], "order presentation keeps both differently placed flower-bed outlets")
	_expect(view.flow_edges.has([0, 1]) and view.flow_edges.has([0, 4]), "order presentation carries both real water branches")
	_expect(view.order_index == 0 and view.order_count == 3 and view.order_brief == "東北＋西南雙花床", "order presentation exposes active contract context")
	var shown_cells: Array = view.cells
	var shown_edges: Array = view.flow_edges
	var shown_targets: Array = view.order_targets
	var shown_starts: Array = view._flow_starts
	var shown_lengths: Array = view._flow_lengths
	var shown_outlets: Array = view._target_outlet_paths
	model.step(0.1)
	var same_state: Dictionary = model.snapshot()

func _solve_active_order(model, order: Dictionary) -> void:
	for cell in range(16):
		var rotated := int(model.cells[cell])
		var turns := 0
		while rotated != int(order.solution_cells[cell]) and turns < 4:
			rotated = ((rotated << 1) & 15) | (rotated >> 3)
			turns += 1
		for _turn in range(turns):
			model.rotate(cell)

func _expect(condition: bool, message: String) -> void:
	checks += 1
	if condition:
		return
	failures += 1
	push_error("Pipe plan view check failed: " + message)
